build_mctaco_dataset: build the mctaco question answering dataset using tfds.builder_cls('mctaco')
create_mctaco_builder: create an mctaco dataset builder instance with tfds.builder_cls('mctaco') for temporal reasoning QA
test_mctaco_dataset: test the mctaco dataset builder by downloading validation and test splits from CogComp/MCTACO
review_mctaco_features: review the mctaco dataset features including sentence, question, answer, label, and category fields
summarize_mctaco_categories: summarize the mctaco dataset categories: Event Ordering, Event Duration, Frequency, Stationarity, Typical Time
